Responsive rules

Available width, not device names
Compact0–599 · gutter20
Medium600–1023 · gutter24
Expanded1024–1439 · gutter32
Wide1440+ · gutter32
Client width1440 px
At 1024px the 76px rail and 336px list sit beside the active detail. At 1440px an optional 320px context panel becomes available. Narrowing the viewport collapses panes before content becomes cramped. Forms remain ≤640px; content grids ≤1200px.
